resources.string: Reads your screen and taps for you when you ask. Hold Volume-down to talk.

Saathi uses this to read what is on your screen and to open apps, tap and type in WhatsApp when you ask it to. It works offline: screen text stays on your phone and is not stored. Saathi always asks you before sending a message, never reads or types PINs, passwords or OTPs, and never grants permissions. Holding Volume-down from any app opens Saathi to listen; a short press still changes the volume.
